title: Stylistic inversion and fronting · 倒装与前置（书面与文学语体）
pattern: Never + auxiliary + subject + verb  ·  Adverb phrase + verb + subject
summary: 句首放入否定词或表示方式、地点的状语时，要把助动词或动词提到主语前面，使句子更正式、更有修辞效果。
explanation: 英语的普通语序是「主语 + 谓语」，例如 I have never seen such a mess.。但在书面语、文学作品、正式演讲和评论中，作者常把某些词语移到句首以加强语气，这就是**倒装**（inversion）或**前置**（fronting）。Never have I seen such a mess. 的意思相同，语气却更郑重。

最常见的一类是**否定词或否定短语**位于句首，例如 never、rarely、seldom、hardly、little、not only、no sooner、under no circumstances。此时要把助动词（do / does / did、have / has / had、be）放到主语前面：Seldom **does** he complain. 如果原句没有助动词，先借助 do / does / did：He seldom complains → Seldom **does** he complain.
另一类是**方位或方向副词**前置，多用于描写场景，动词通常是不及物动词，且主语是名词时才倒装：Down came the rain. / Into the room walked a tall stranger. 如果主语是人称代词，则不倒装：Here **he** comes. 而不是 Here comes he.

还有 only + 时间状语 + 倒装句 的结构，表示“直到……才……”：Only after the funeral **did** she realise how much he had meant to her. 另外，hardly / scarcely … when 表示“刚一……就……”，要用 had + 过去分词倒装：Hardly **had** we arrived when the phone rang. Hence、Thus 放在句首时后面通常不倒装，而是接名词短语：Hence the importance of early diagnosis.
使用时要注意语体：倒装主要见于书面语和文学、演讲、正式评论，日常口语中很少这样说，写作中也不宜滥用，否则会显得做作。中文没有这种语序变化，所以中国学生最容易漏掉助动词，或者把倒装和普通语序混在一起。
mistakes: ✗ Never I have seen such a chaotic meeting. → ✓ Never have I seen such a chaotic meeting. 否定副词 never 位于句首时，助动词要提到主语前面。
✗ Not only he apologised, but he also paid for the damage. → ✓ Not only did he apologise, but he also paid for the damage. 句首是 not only 时，后面的主语与助动词同样要倒装，原句没有助动词就补上 did。
✗ Hardly had we arrived, the phone rang. → ✓ Hardly had we arrived when the phone rang. hardly … when 是固定搭配，when 不能省略，否则句子不完整。

examples.text: Down came the rain, and the match was abandoned.
examples.translation: 大雨倾盆而下，比赛被取消了。
examples.note: 方向副词 down 前置，主语是名词 the rain，所以动词 came 在主语前。

examples.text: Never have I seen such a chaotic meeting.
examples.translation: 我从没见过如此混乱的会议。
examples.note: 否定副词 never 前置，倒装。

examples.text: Hardly had we arrived when the phone rang.
Not only did the company cut costs, but it also improved quality.
examples.translation: 公司不但削减了成本，还提高了质量。

examples.text: Only after the funeral did she realise how much he had meant to her.
examples.translation: 直到葬礼之后，她才意识到他对自己有多重要。
examples.note: only + 状语从句前置，主句倒装。

examples.text: Seldom does a novel capture everyday life so faithfully.
examples.translation: 很少有小说能如此真实地描绘日常生活。
examples.note: 原句 A novel seldom captures… 需借助 does 才能倒装。

examples.text: Hence the importance of clear communication in any team.
examples.translation: 这就是为什么任何团队都需要清晰的沟通。
examples.note: hence 后接名词短语，没有动词，无需倒装。

exercises.translation: 我从没听过这么荒唐的话。
options: Never I
Not never
Never
Never has
exercises.explanation: 句首的 Never 是否定副词，后面要倒装：Never have I heard…。其余选项都会破坏倒装结构。

exercises.sentence: Little ___ she know at the time that the letter was a forgery.
exercises.translation: 当时她根本不知道那封信是伪造的。
options: does
was
had
did
exercises.explanation: Little 位于句首表示否定，要倒装；语境是过去，所以用 did：Little did she know…。

exercises.sentence: Hardly ___ we arrived when the phone rang.
options: were
did
is
had
exercises.explanation: hardly … when 结构要用 had + 过去分词倒装：Hardly had we arrived…。

exercises.source: 直到演出结束，他才意识到自己错了。
options: Did only after the show had ended he realise he was wrong.
Only after the show had ended did he realise he was wrong.
Only after the show had ended did he realised he was wrong.
Only after the show had ended he was realising he was wrong.
exercises.explanation: Only 短语放在句首时，主句要倒装：did he realise。第三句 realised 形式错误，第四句 was realising 意思也不对。

exercises.source: 很少有小说能如此真实地描写日常生活。
options: Seldom a novel does capture everyday life so faithfully.
Seldom does a novel captures everyday life so faithfully.
Seldom does a novel capture everyday life so faithfully.
A novel seldom does capture everyday life so faithful.
exercises.explanation: Seldom 置于句首，后接 does + 主语 + 动词原形；副词应为 faithfully，不能用形容词 faithful。

options: Little did they expect such a warm welcome.
Never I have seen such a chaotic meeting.
Hardly had she sat down when the bell rang.
exercises.explanation: Never 位于句首时要倒装，应为 Never have I seen such a chaotic meeting.

options: Under no circumstances should the door be left open.
Rarely does a day pass without some news.
Not only he apologised, but he also paid for the damage.
exercises.explanation: Not only 位于句首时，后面要倒装：Not only did he apologise…。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 大雨倾盆而下，比赛被取消了。
exercises.explanation: 方位副词 down 前置，动词 came 放在名词主语 the rain 之前。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.explanation: hardly 位于句首，助动词 had 提到主语 we 之前，when 从句紧随其后。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.explanation: 否定副词 seldom 前置，原句 He seldom complains 需借助 does 倒装。
